data.name: Svc_Explain
data.value: Watched services (SQL Server, IIS, Redis, CodeMeter, RabbitMQ, SSRS, antivirus …). RSM only shows them; starting or stopping a service is never possible from RSM. Red = Automatic but stopped.

data.name: DotNet_Explain
data.value: Optional, local only, off by default (site settings). RSM opens an EventPipe session limited to the System.Runtime and ASP.NET Core counters of the w3wp (in-process) or dotnet (out-of-process) processes. It never takes dumps, attaches profilers or changes the process.

data.name: DotNet_NoData
data.value: No data yet: connect the live view on the App server itself.

data.name: Packs_Explain
data.value: Team query packs live in this folder next to RSM.exe (one sub-folder per pack: manifest.json + *.sql). Every file is checked by SqlGuard when RSM starts; a refused file is never run and its reason is listed below. RSM has no SQL editor.

data.name: Rabbit_NotConfigured
data.value: The RabbitMQ management API is off (not configured for this node). The RabbitMQ service state is on the Services page.

data.name: Redis_AppNodesMissing
data.value: No connection from these App nodes: {0}

data.name: Redis_NotConfigured
data.value: Redis is not configured for this node.

data.name: Redis_Slowlog

data.name: Ssrs_NotFound
data.value: No ReportServer database found (or not accessible) on this node.

data.name: Ssrs_Reports
data.value: Reports (slow ones in red: p95 over 60 s)

data.name: Ssrs_Truncated
data.value: Only the latest {0} executions were analysed.

data.name: Topo_Explain
data.value: Discovered read-only from ARR farms, SQL sessions (per client host) and Redis CLIENT LIST of every node. Numbers are farm weights, SQL sessions and Redis connections. Dashed links come from the site profile only.

data.name: Sites_VersionFileHint
data.value: Optional relative path inside the Rahkaran application folder whose fingerprint identifies the build on each App node (RK-001). Empty = compare app path segments only.

data.name: Sites_DotNetOn
data.value: On — EventPipe counters are read on the local App server

data.name: Sites_DotNetWarning
data.value: RSM will attach a diagnostics session (EventPipe, counters only) to the w3wp/dotnet processes of the Rahkaran pools on the server where RSM runs. It does not take dumps or change the process, but it adds a small overhead to the production process. Enable?
